   DROP TABLE EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT;
END;

BEGIN
   DROP VIEW EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT;
END;


CREATE TABLE EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(BASE_NO)
)
AS
SELECT BR_CD
	, SUB_BR_CD
	, BASE_NO
	, CUST_NO
	, PORTFOLIO_NO
	, ACC_NO
	, ACC_TYPE
	, ACC_NAME
	, ACC_CCY
	, ACC_STATUS
	, RISK_PROFILE
	, LAST_REVIEW_DATE
	, CITY
	, ZIP_CODE
	, STATUS
	, MAKER_ID
	, MAKER_DATE
	, AUTH_ID
	, AUTH_DATE
	, REMARKS
	, BALANCE
	, INTER_COMP_ACCT
	, ACCT_CREATION_TYPE
	, LEGAL_ENTITY
	, LEGACY_ACC_NO
	, SOURCE_TYPE
	, SOURCE_DESC
	, VERSION
	, HELD_WITH_BANK
	, HOLDING_STATEMENT
	, ACCT_SUB_TYPE
	, ACCT_OPEN_DT
	, RM_ID
	, TAXABLE
	, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
	, DISPOSITION_ACCT
	, BANK_NAME
	, PREFERRED_FLAG
	, LAST6_BASE_NO
	, LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO
	, LAST6_ACC_NO
	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT BR_CD
		, SUB_BR_CD
		, BASE_NO
		, CUST_NO
		, PORTFOLIO_NO
		, ACC_NO
		, ACC_TYPE
		, ACC_NAME
		, ACC_CCY
		, ACC_STATUS
		, RISK_PROFILE
		, LAST_REVIEW_DATE
		, CITY
		, ZIP_CODE
		, STATUS
		, MAKER_ID
		, MAKER_DATE
		, AUTH_ID
		, AUTH_DATE
		, REMARKS
		, BALANCE
		, INTER_COMP_ACCT
		, ACCT_CREATION_TYPE
		, LEGAL_ENTITY
		, LEGACY_ACC_NO
		, SOURCE_TYPE
		, SOURCE_DESC
		, VERSION
		, HELD_WITH_BANK
		, HOLDING_STATEMENT
		, ACCT_SUB_TYPE
		, ACCT_OPEN_DT
		, RM_ID
		, TAXABLE
		, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
		, DISPOSITION_ACCT
		, BANK_NAME
		, PREFERRED_FLAG
		, LAST6_BASE_NO
		, LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO
		, LAST6_ACC_NO
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
	
		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY ACC_NO, BASE_NO, PORTFOLIO_NO
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT BR_CD
			, SUB_BR_CD
			, BASE_NO
			, CUST_NO
			, PORTFOLIO_NO
			, ACC_NO
			, ACC_TYPE
			, ACC_NAME
			, ACC_CCY
			, ACC_STATUS
			, RISK_PROFILE
			, LAST_REVIEW_DATE
			, CITY
			, ZIP_CODE
			, STATUS
			, MAKER_ID
			, MAKER_DATE
			, AUTH_ID
			, AUTH_DATE
			, REMARKS
			, BALANCE
			, INTER_COMP_ACCT
			, ACCT_CREATION_TYPE
			, LEGAL_ENTITY
			, LEGACY_ACC_NO
			, SOURCE_TYPE
			, SOURCE_DESC
			, VERSION
			, HELD_WITH_BANK
			, HOLDING_STATEMENT
			, ACCT_SUB_TYPE
			, ACCT_OPEN_DT
			, RM_ID
			, TAXABLE
			, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
			, DISPOSITION_ACCT
			, BANK_NAME
			, PREFERRED_FLAG
			, LAST6_BASE_NO
			, LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO
			, LAST6_ACC_NO
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

			, row_number() 
				over( partition by BR_CD
						, SUB_BR_CD
						, BASE_NO
						, CUST_NO
						, PORTFOLIO_NO
						, ACC_NO
						, ACC_TYPE
						, ACC_NAME
						, ACC_CCY
						, ACC_STATUS
						, RISK_PROFILE
						, LAST_REVIEW_DATE
						, CITY
						, ZIP_CODE
						, STATUS
						, MAKER_ID
						, MAKER_DATE
						, AUTH_ID
						, AUTH_DATE
						, REMARKS
						, BALANCE
						, INTER_COMP_ACCT
						, ACCT_CREATION_TYPE
						, LEGAL_ENTITY
						, LEGACY_ACC_NO
						, SOURCE_TYPE
						, SOURCE_DESC
						, VERSION
						, HELD_WITH_BANK
						, HOLDING_STATEMENT
						, ACCT_SUB_TYPE
						, ACCT_OPEN_DT
						, RM_ID
						, TAXABLE
						, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
						, DISPOSITION_ACCT
						, BANK_NAME
						, PREFERRED_FLAG
						, LAST6_BASE_NO
						, LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO
						, LAST6_ACC_NO
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME

					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.TRU_ACCOUNT

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;

			, MAKER_ID
			, CIF_NO
			, LAST6_CUST_NO
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

			, row_number() 
				over( partition by CUST_NO
						, PRIMARY_FLAG
						, BR_CD
						, STATUS
						, AUTH_DT
						, AUTH_ID
						, MAKER_DT
						, MAKER_ID
						, CIF_NO
						, LAST6_CUST_NO
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME

					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK

	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1

	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
